source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When a passenger unit leaves the Kill Rig during your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), the Rig can use Beastscent if its own unit is free of Battle-shock. Make a level 1 Psychic roll on a D6. A result of 1 leaves the Kill Rig’s unit Battle-shocked. Until turn end, the passenger unit gets +1 to wound against **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** targets.
